verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no simulated-conversation testing, test harness, or eval framework for agents. The Web Call SDK provides live browser conversations, but it is documented as a deployment channel for web pages, not a simulation or eval tool. Call history supports debugging only after real executions. These are adjacent features and earn no credit for pre-deployment testing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test agents with simulated conversations or evals before putting them on real phone calls
